note: Fingerprints for conversational-AI and synthetic-content tooling detectable in page source. aiNature drives EU AI Act Article 50(1) applicability reasoning.

aiNatureLegend.ai-native: Product is an LLM/AI agent by design. Art.50(1) disclosure duty applies to the deployer.
aiNatureLegend.ai-optional: Vendor ships both scripted and AI/LLM modes. Duty applies if AI mode is enabled - requires operator confirmation.
aiNatureLegend.rule-based: Scripted flows, no LLM by default. Art.50(1) may still apply where the interface presents as human.
aiNatureLegend.content-gen: Generates or edits synthetic media. Engages Art.50(2) machine-readable marking duty.
